Immobiliare.it, Idealista, Subito.it son: Immobiliare.it, Idealista and Subito.it are the main ones. Filter by "affitto" (rent) and your city. Be wary of listings with no photos or with prices that are too low.
Trovano casa più in fretta ma chiedono u: They find a home faster but charge a fee (usually one month's rent + VAT). Useful if language is a barrier — many have multilingual staff.
Gruppi Facebook della comunità srilankes: Sri Lankan community Facebook groups for your city, parish noticeboards, local associations. Rooms are often cheaper this way.
Case popolari (ERP): si accede tramite b: Social housing (ERP): you apply through a municipal call. You need a valid residence permit and a low ISEE. The wait is long but the rent is far lower.
Passaporto + permesso di soggiorno valid: Passport + valid residence permit (or long-term residence card). A copy is attached to the contract.
Obbligatorio per registrare il contratto: Required to register the contract with the Agenzia delle Entrate. You get it free of charge at the Agenzia or at the consulate.
Il proprietario vuole spesso 3 ultime bu: Landlords often ask for your last 3 payslips or your CUD/730. You show that you earn at least 3× the monthly rent.
Lettera del precedente padrone di casa o: A letter from your previous landlord or your employer. Not compulsory, but they help a lot, especially for newcomers.
Alcune case popolari o aiuti al canone r: Some social housing schemes and rent subsidies require the ISEE. Request it free of charge at a CAF.
Se il tuo reddito non è sufficiente, il: If your income is not enough, the landlord may ask for a guarantor (for example your employer or a relative) who agrees to pay if you fall behind.
4 years + an automatic renewal for another 4.
uso abitativo stabile. Il proprietario p: stable housing. The landlord can only terminate for specific reasons (for example personal use).
fissato da accordi territoriali (più bas: set by local agreements (below market rate).
cedolare secca al 10% per il proprietari: a 10% flat tax for the landlord → they often accept foreign tenants more readily.
da 1 a 18 mesi, non rinnovabile automati: from 1 to 18 months, not automatically renewable.
chi ha esigenze temporanee (lavoro stagi: people with temporary needs (seasonal work, waiting for permanent housing).
university students studying away from home.
richiede iscrizione all'università della: requires enrolment at a university in that city.
Per legge max 3 mesi. Restituito alla fi: By law, 3 months maximum. Returned at the end if the flat is in good order.
Almost always required when you move in.
Solo se hai usato un'agenzia. Illegale s: Only if you used an agency. It is unlawful if charged by the landlord's own agency.
Divide tra proprietario e inquilino (met: Split between landlord and tenant (half each). With the flat-tax regime, only the landlord pays.
Verificare se incluse nel canone o separ: Check whether they are included in the rent or separate (cleaning, lift, central heating).
Di solito a carico dell'inquilino. Si di: Usually paid by the tenant. You declare it at the town hall.
Il contratto deve essere registrato all': The contract must be registered with the Agenzia delle Entrate within 30 days. Without registration it is not legally valid.
Hai diritto a registrare la residenza al: You have the right to register your residence at your address. The landlord cannot stop you — it is a fundamental right.
Piccole riparazioni (fino a ~€100) sono: Small repairs (up to about €100) are yours to pay. Major repairs (boiler, roof, systems) are always the landlord's responsibility.
Puoi disdire il contratto 6 mesi prima (: You can end the contract with 6 months' notice (4+4 contract) or 30 days' notice (temporary contract). Send a registered letter with return receipt, or a PEC email.
È illegale rifiutare l'affitto per nazio: Refusing to rent to you because of your nationality or religion is unlawful. If it happens you can report it to UNAR (the national anti-discrimination office).
Se hai ISEE basso, puoi richiedere il co: If your ISEE is low you can apply for a rent contribution from your town hall. The amount and the requirements vary by city.
ti chiedono di pagare il deposito prima: they ask you to pay the deposit before you see the place; the price is far too low for the area; the "landlord" is abroad and will post you the keys; they will not let you visit the flat; there is no written contract.
Always visit the flat in person. Ask for the land registry record (visura catastale) to check who really owns it.
Fai foto/video dell'appartamento il gior: Take photos and videos of the flat on the day you move in. Sign a handover report with the landlord.
Segnala alla Polizia Postale (commissari: Report it to the Polizia Postale (commissariatodips.it) and to your city's consumer advice desk.
